Robotex International Preliminaries

The preliminary round of Robotex International Estonia will take place on November 7, starting at 10 a.m., in the TalTech sports building.

Address: Männliiva tn 7, Tallinn

Robotex International 2025 Estonian preliminary round LEGO SUMO: https://forms.gle/bqUH8y2mjErsRqzR6

Robotex International 2025 Estonian preliminary round LEGO Line Following: https://forms.gle/b1p6hqMVNKeh73E47

Robotex International 2025 Estonian preliminary round Folkrace: https://forms.gle/pzYubAqpUf2MUyXN6

The Robotex International Estonian preliminary round will take place on November 7th starting at 11 am in the TalTech sports hall, registration and technical inspection will start at 10 am.

Registration is open until October 31st, 2025.

This year, there will be one all-Estonian Robotex International preliminary competition, which guarantees the best participation in the main Robotex competition on December 5 and 6 at Unibet Arena.

The Lego sumo registration form is located at here.Registration for Lego Line Following is at here.

QR-pileti kasutamine

QR-pilet tuleb valideerida ühissõiduki esiukse juures oleva validaatori abil. Selleks aseta nutiseadme ekraanil kuvatav või paberile prinditud QR-kood validaatori koodilugeja ekraani juurde.

Lae pilet alla

X

How to use QR tickets?

A QR ticket must be validated at the bottom of the rectangular orange validator located at the front door of the public transport vehicle: place the QR code displayed on a smart device screen or printed on paper in front of the code reader screen situated at the lower part of the rectangular validator.
